responsibility: Declares the compiler-side interface shared by GCC’s sanitizer passes for AddressSanitizer and HWASan, including entry points for stack/global instrumentation, internal-function expansion, file-level initialization, shadow-memory helpers, and stack-tagging support. It also centralizes sanitizer constants and policy helpers such as ASan shadow geometry, red-zone sizing, stack magic values, HWASan tag/granule ABI macros, intercepted builtin classification, and predicates controlling which functions, variables, and coverage options should be sanitized.
same_name_distinction: Header companion to gcc/asan.cc that exposes the shared compiler-side ASan/HWASan interface and ABI/policy macros. Unlike gcc/asan.cc, it does not implement instrumentation passes; it centralizes declarations, shadow/red-zone constants, tag/granule macros, and inline predicates used across sanitizer code.
